pois.name: Lanterna di Genova
pois.intro: The Lighthouse of Genoa, often known as simply La Lanterna, is the main light serving the Port of Genoa, the capital of Liguria, Italy. Besides being an important aid to night navigation in the vicinity, the tower serves as a symbol and a landmark for the city of Genoa.

pois.name: Galleria Nazionale di Palazzo Spinola
pois.openingHours: Tu-Sa 08:30-19:30; Mo off; Su, PH off
pois.intro: La Galleria Nazionale di Palazzo Spinola è un museo statale collocato all'interno di palazzo Spinola di Pellicceria, un edificio nobiliare cinquecentesco sito al civico 1 di piazza di Pellicceria, nel cuore del centro storico di Genova. Il 13 luglio 2006 è stato inserito nella lista dei quarantadue palazzi iscritti ai Rolli di Genova, dichiarati dall'UNESCO patrimonio dell'umanità.

pois.name: PestoBene
pois.address: 1 rosso Via di San Pietro della Porta, 16123

pois.name: Palazzo Rosso
pois.intro: The Palazzo Brignole Sale or Palazzo Rosso is a house museum located in Via Garibaldi, in the historical center of Genoa, in Northwestern Italy. The palace is part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site Genoa: Le Strade Nuove and the system of the Palazzi dei Rolli.

pois.name: Cattedrale di San Lorenzo
pois.intro: Genoa Cathedral or Metropolitan Cathedral of Saint Lawrence is a Roman Catholic cathedral in the Italian city of Genoa. It is dedicated to Saint Lawrence, and is the seat of the Archbishop of Genoa.

pois.name: Palazzo Ducale
pois.intro: The Doge's Palace is a historical building in Genoa, northwest Italy. Once the home of the doges of Genoa, it is now a museum and a centre for cultural events and arts exhibitions.

pois.name: La Lanterna de Genova
pois.intro: The Lighthouse of Genoa, often known as simply La Lanterna, is the main light serving the Port of Genoa, the capital of Liguria, Italy. Besides being an important aid to night navigation in the vicinity, the tower serves as a symbol and a landmark for the city of Genoa.

pois.name: Acquario di Genova
pois.intro: The Aquarium of Genoa is the largest aquarium in Italy and one of the most significant in Europe. It is located in the Old Harbour area of Genoa, Liguria, and was designed by the architect Renzo Piano as part of the urban redevelopment project created for the Expo 1992, celebrating the 500th anniversary of Christopher Columbus’s voyage to the Americas.

pois.name: Piazza Raffaele De Ferrari
pois.intro: Piazza De Ferrari is the main square of Genoa. Situated in the heart of the city between the historical and the modern center, Piazza De Ferrari is renowned for its fountain, which was restored in recent years along with a major restyling of the square.

pois.name: Cimitero Monumentale di Staglieno
pois.intro: The Cimitero monumentale di Staglieno is an extensive monumental cemetery located on a hillside in the district of Staglieno of Genoa, Italy, famous for its monumental sculpture. Covering an area of more than a square kilometre, it is one of the largest cemeteries in Europe.

pois.name: Museo Palazzo Reale di Genova
pois.intro: The Palazzo Reale or Palazzo Stefano Balbi is a major palace in Genoa.

pois.name: Palazzo Bianco
pois.intro: Palazzo Bianco is one of the main buildings of the center of Genoa, Italy. It is situated at 11, via Garibaldi.

pois.name: Palazzo Doria-Tursi
pois.intro: The palazzo Doria-Tursi or palazzo Niccolò Grimaldi is a building on Via Giuseppe Garibaldi in the historic town centre of Genoa. With Palazzo Rosso and Palazzo Bianco it houses the Strada Nuova Museums.

pois.name: Basilica della Santissima Annunziata del Vastato
pois.wikipedia: it:Basilica della Santissima Annunziata del Vastato
pois.intro: The Basilica della Santissima Annunziata del Vastato is a prominent Roman Catholic church of Genoa, northern Italy; its decoration employed the major baroque studios and artists in Genoa in the 17th century. It is named Vastato because the area where it was built was outside the walls of the city, in an area where houses had been demolished for defensive reasons.

pois.name: Palazzo San Giorgio
pois.intro: The Palazzo San Giorgio or Palace of St. George is one of the most important and well-known historic buildings in Genoa.

pois.name: Museo Civico di Storia Naturale Giacomo Doria
pois.wikipedia: it:Museo di storia naturale Giacomo Doria
pois.intro: The Museo Civico di Storia Naturale Giacomo Doria is a natural history museum in Genoa, northern Italy. It is named after the naturalist Giacomo Doria, who was the founder and the curator for over forty years.

pois.name: Arco ai Caduti
pois.intro: The Arco della Vittoria, also known as the Monument to the Fallen or Arch of the Fallen, is a memorial monument located in Piazza della Vittoria in Genoa. It was erected in memory of the Genoese who fell during World War I. The work was designed by the architect Marcello Piacentini with the collaboration of the sculptor Arturo Dazzi.

pois.name: Villa del Principe
pois.intro: The Villa del Principe, Palazzo del Principe, or Palace of Andrea Doria in Fassolo is one of the main historical suburban villas of Genoa, Italy. It was built in the 16th century in an area that is now located in the city center, but at the time of the construction of the villa was just outside of the city walls towards Capo di Faro and the Lanterna.

pois.name: Museo d'arte orientale Edoardo Chiossone
pois.description: Il museo ospita opere giapponesi di varie epoche: pittura (dal XI al XIX sec.), armi e armature, smalti, ceramiche, lacche, porcellane, stampe policrome, strumenti musicali, maschere teatrali, costumi e tessuti, bronzistica, grandi sculture.
pois.intro: The Edoardo Chiossone Museum of Oriental Art in Genoa, Italy is an important collection of Asian art, one of the most significant collections in Europe and in Italy, along with the museums of Venice and Rome. The museum hosts the huge collection of Edoardo Chiossone, who spent 23 years in Japan.

pois.name: José Martí
pois.description: Traduzione della poesia a cura di Edoardo Sanguineti
pois.intro: José Julián Martí Pérez was a Cuban nationalist, poet, philosopher, essayist, journalist, translator, professor, and publisher, who is considered a Cuban national hero because of his role in the liberation of his country from Spain. He was also an important figure in Latin American literature.

pois.name: Bigo Ascensore panoramico
pois.intro: The Bigo is an architectural structure located in the Old Port of Genoa, designed by architect Renzo Piano. Built for the Genoa Expo '92, it has become one of the main symbols of the urban redevelopment of the Ligurian capital.

pois.name: Galeone Neptune
pois.description: Galeone costruito ed utilizzato come set del film "Pirati" di Roman Polanski
pois.intro: Neptune is a ship replica of a fictional 17th-century galleon designed by naval architect David Cannell. The ship was built in 1985 for Roman Polanski's film Pirates, where she portrayed the Spanish ship of the same name.

pois.name: Galata Museo del Mare
pois.intro: The Galata - Museo del mare is a maritime museum in the Italian city of Genoa. It is the largest museum of its kind in the Mediterranean area and also one of the most modern in Italy.

pois.name: Castello D'Albertis
pois.intro: D'Albertis Castle is a historic residence located in Genoa, in the north-western region of Italy. The castle was the former home of sea captain Enrico Alberto d'Albertis and was donated to the city of Genoa upon his death in 1932.

pois.name: Groove
pois.address: 32 rosso Via ai quattro canti di San Francesco, Genova, 16124

pois.name: La Teiera Magica
pois.description: They mainly serve tea and cakes, but also coffee and soft drinks

pois.name: Strakkino
pois.address: 18 rosso Via alla Porta degli Archi

pois.name: Orto Botanico dell'Università degli Studi di Genova
pois.intro: The Orto Botanico dell'Università di Genova, also known as the Orto Botanico di Genova, is a botanical garden operated by the University of Genoa, and located at Corso Dogali, Genoa, Liguria, Italy.

pois.name: Villa Rosazza
pois.intro: Villa Di Negro Rosazza "dello Scoglietto" or "lo Scoglietto" is a villa located in the quarter of San Teodoro in Genoa, Northwestern Italy. It was built in 1565 for the Doge Ambrogio Di Negro o for his son Orazio, in a coastal area that used to be outside of the city walls.

pois.name: Piazza della Vittoria
pois.intro: La place de la Victoire est une des principales places, avec la Piazza De Ferrari, de Gênes en Ligurie. Elle se trouve dans le centre de la ville, près de la gare de Gênes-Brignole et du moderne centre directionnel de Corte Lambruschini.

pois.name: Villetta Di Negro
pois.intro: Villetta Di Negro, o Villetta Dinegro, è un parco pubblico di Genova. È situato nella zona più orientale del sestiere della Maddalena, a poca distanza dalla centrale piazza Corvetto e a poche decine di metri dal Palazzo del Governo, il cui ingresso è posto su via Roma.

pois.name: Scalinata delle Tre Caravelle
pois.intro: L'Escalier des Caravelles ou Escalier des Trois Caravelles est un site particulièrement caractéristique du centre de Gênes. Il a été conçu en 1922 et 1938 dans le cadre d'un projet de réaménagement de la zone.

pois.name: Villa Imperiale
pois.intro: La Villa Imperiale ou Villa Imperiale Cattaneo est l'une des plus anciennes et des plus prestigieuses villas Renaissance avec parc de la ville de Gênes. Située dans le quartier de San Fruttuoso, dans la partie orientale du centre historique de Gênes, elle appartient à la commune et est utilisée, avec le parc environnant, comme structure publique et jardin.

pois.name: Monte Figogna
pois.intro: Monte Figogna is a mountain in Liguria, northern Italy, part of the Ligurian Apennines. It is located in the Municipality of Ceranesi, about 20 km from the city of Genoa.

pois.name: Torre Grimaldina
pois.description: La torre è stata restaurata e aperta al pubblico con visite guidate su prenotazione.

pois.name: Antica Farmacia Sant'Anna
pois.intro: The Antica Farmacia Sant'Anna is a pharmacy and herbal medicine dispensary in Genoa, Italy, located in the quarter of Castelletto. Founded by the Discalced Carmelites friars of the annex Convent of Sant’Anna in 1650, it is the oldest commercial establishment still operating in Genoa and the only instance in Italy of a fully licensed pharmacy owned and operated by a religious institution.

pois.name: Museo delle culture del mondo
pois.openingHours: Apr-Sep Tu-Su 10:00-18:00; Oct-Mar Tu-Su 10:00-17:00; Mo off
pois.intro: Il Museo delle Culture del Mondo è uno dei musei di Genova, aperto in occasione di Genova capitale europea della cultura 2004 all'interno del castello D'Albertis, antica dimora del capitano Enrico Alberto d'Albertis sul colle di Montegalletto.

pois.name: Via del Campo 29 Rosso
pois.intro: Il Via del Campo 29 rosso, soprannominato la "casa dei cantautori genovesi", è un museo che si trova nel centro storico di Genova e prende il nome dalla via e dal numero civico in cui sono siti i locali, nei quali, fino al 2010, si trovava il negozio di dischi e strumenti musicali Musica Gianni Tassio, frequentato dal famoso cantautore genovese Fabrizio De André, il principale artista a cui il mus...

pois.name: Porta Soprana
pois.description: Una delle due porte principale delle mura costruite fra il 1155 e il 1160 e dette "del Barbarossa".
pois.intro: Die Porta Soprana war ehemals ein Stadttor der italienischen Hafenstadt Genua. Sie zählt zu den wichtigsten noch erhaltenen Bauten des Mittelalters in der Stadt und befindet sich auf dem höchsten Punkt der Sant’Andrea-Ebene.

pois.name: Palazzo Lomellini Doria Lamba
pois.intro: The Palazzo Lomellini-Doria Lamb', also called Palazzo Stefano Lomellini, is a building in Via Cairoli at number 18 in the historical centre of Genoa, included on 13 July 2006 in the list of the 42 palaces inscribed in the Rolli di Genova, which on that date became World Heritage by UNESCO.

pois.name: Castello Mackenzie
pois.intro: The Mackenzie Castle is a historical manor in the Castelletto quarter of Genoa, northern Italy. It is an example of Gothic Revival architecture.
